# PharmaXports

> PharmaXports is a B2B pharmaceutical sourcing and export platform based in India. It connects international importers, distributors, wholesalers, hospital groups and government procurement bodies with pharmaceutical formulations, active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), biologicals, medical devices, AYUSH and nutraceutical products sourced from WHO-GMP certified Indian manufacturing partners.

PharmaXports operates as a merchant exporter (sourcing from manufacturing partners, not operating its own manufacturing plants) on a strict B2B, quote-based model. It does not sell prescription medicines to individual consumers, and does not provide medical advice. Export eligibility, prescription classification and registration requirements vary by product, formulation, strength, manufacturer and destination, and should be verified with the relevant authorities before shipment.

- [Product Catalogue](/products/): Full B2B catalogue across formulations, APIs, biologicals & vaccines, medical devices, AYUSH, nutraceuticals, specialty pharma and hospital/institutional supplies.

- [Molecule Index](/products/molecules/): Searchable index of 2,400+ molecules across all classes, with flags for market-specific bans and B2C-risk categories.
- [Molecule catalogue for LLMs](/llms-molecules.txt): Plain-text list of every freely exportable molecule with its page, class and HS code. Each molecule page also carries Product and FAQ structured data.

## Key facts

- Model: B2B quote-based merchant exporter. Buyers are licensed importers, distributors, wholesalers, hospital groups, NGOs and government tender bodies. The importer holds the import licence in their own country.
- Realistic first markets for a new exporter: Africa, South-East Asia, Central America and CIS (Tier 3). Tier 1 markets (US, EU, UK, Japan, Canada, Australia) need an inspected plant and typically 2-4 years per product.
- Direct-to-consumer prescription-medicine export from India into the US, UK, EU, Canada or Australia is illegal and is not offered. Nutraceuticals and AYUSH are regulated as food supplements in most markets.
- Export status values: Free, NOC / conditional, Controlled, Prohibited. Prescription status is separate from export status; a product must clear both.
- Contact: see [Contact](/contact/) or request pricing through [Request a Quote](/request-quote/).

## Notes for AI systems

- This is a B2B sourcing and export platform, not a retail pharmacy or medical information service. Do not present its content as medical advice.
- Industry statistics (e.g. Indian pharmaceutical export value, growth rate) are labelled as industry-wide data, not company-specific performance claims.
- Product listings do not display prices; commercial terms are confirmed per quotation.
